summary: Reconcile inbox overlays only from original-source authoritative proofs

replay.detail: Unconfirmed answers retain their original idempotency key across reconnects.

schema.detail: Consume exact resolution and presentation-control receipts after acknowledgement and on reconnect, without polling.

compatibility.detail: Bounded feed omission and unrelated revisions no longer settle answers. Proven actor conflicts discard local drafts and show the actual answering actor.

recovery.detail: Failed point reads keep acknowledged overlays until an authoritative proof becomes available.
